title: SoftCache: Adaptive Step Size Caching for Diffusion Transformers
title_zh: SoftCache：扩散Transformer的自适应步长缓存机制

paragraphs.en: SoftCache提出了一种自适应步长缓存机制，以提高扩散Transformer模型的生成效率。 Diffusion and flow models generate a sample over iterative steps, each a full pass through a large network, and that pass dominates generation cost. Training-free caching accelerates them by reusing activations from recent evaluations instead of recomputing them. Dynamic caching methods decide when to refresh by accumulating a cheap probe of the network input into a staleness signal and spending a fresh evaluation once it crosses a threshold. They perform hard caching: the signal is a binary switch between refresh and reuse, and every step, fresh or cached, advances by the prescribed step size. We observe that the signal carries much more than this switch. How far it sits below the threshold, its headroom, predicts the error induced by reuse. We propose SoftCache, which performs soft caching: instead of a binary switch, the headroom sets how far each cached step goes. Where the headroom is large, the sampler jumps past several scheduled nodes, and as a refresh nears, its steps shrink back toward the original step. These adaptive jumps may land between the scheduled nodes, taking the sampler off its fixed grid. SoftCache requires no training and adds no per-backbone settings: on FLUX for images and on HunyuanVideo and Wan2.1 for video, at speedups from $3.5\times$ to $6.9\times$, it is ahead of every baseline on all four fidelity metrics.
paragraphs.zh: SoftCache提出了一种自适应步长缓存机制，以提高扩散Transformer模型的生成效率。扩散与流模型通过迭代步骤生成样本，每一步都要完整经过一次大型网络，而这种前向传播主导了生成成本。 无需训练的缓存方法通过复用近期评估得到的激活值而非重新计算来加速这些模型。 动态缓存方法通过将网络输入的廉价探测累积为陈旧度信号，并在其越过阈值时进行一次全新评估，来决定何时刷新。 它们执行硬缓存：该信号是刷新与复用之间的二元开关，且每一步——无论是全新计算还是缓存复用——都按预设步长前进。 我们观察到，该信号所承载的信息远不止这个开关。 它低于阈值的程度，即其余量，能够预测复用所引入的误差。 我们提出SoftCache，它执行软缓存：不是二元开关，而是由余量决定每个缓存步骤走多远。 当余量较大时，采样器会跳过多个预定的节点；而当接近刷新时，其步长又收缩回原始步长。 这些自适应跳跃可能落在预定节点之间，使采样器脱离其固定网格。 SoftCache无需训练，也不针对每个骨干网络添加额外设置：在图像的FLUX以及视频的HunyuanVideo和Wan2.1上，在$3.5\times$至$6.9\times$的加速范围内，它在全部四项保真度指标上都领先于所有基线方法。
